OPT-A.name: All BWP plywood (IS 710) carcass + shutters, laminate, ply plinth

qualitative.moisture: fair: ply plinth on floor wicks mopping water; back panel against wall
qualitative.termite: fair: IS 710 calls for preservative treatment (ask for the declaration); floor/wall contact is the weak point
qualitative.rental_damage: good: shutters and shelves replaceable by any carpenter

qualitative.termite: good-fair: wood isolated from masonry/floor; inspectable gap

qualitative.lead_time: as OPT-A + 1-2 days mason for kerb/plinth

OPT-C.name: User proposal: 12 mm granite carcass (sides, partitions, top, base, shelves) + ply shutters on bonded hinge strips

qualitative.repairability: poor: needs stone cutter, matching slab, epoxy
